water.origin: Build a water tank calculator. Elapsed time is 0–6 whole minutes, initially 2. A tank starts with 24 litres and drains 3 litres per minute. Show remaining litres.
changes: Add a control for the drain rate, 2–5 whole litres per minute, initially 3. Stop at zero litres.
Add a line plot of remaining litres at each whole minute from 0 through 6 for the chosen rate.
Replace the plot with a metric for litres drained by the selected time. Retain the remaining-litres metric.

guide: Return only the strict revision packet. Copy artifact and base from context. Each operation adds, replaces or removes one named declaration (OpenUI) or one named elements entry (json-render). value is the RHS expression or the JSON element encoded as a string. Remove uses an empty string. Touch a key at most once. Include root/layout updates when children change. No change is made to surrounding prose. Use version 2. Include initializers with exactly one {role,value} for each newly introduced role, using the requested initial integer. Host water roles are time and rate. Retained or renamed roles must be omitted. Use [] if none are introduced.
context: current artifact, prior user requirements, and host selections; same in both arms
